summary: One-line operand-order swap in Poly.__rmul__'s PolynomialError fallback so the Poly-derived expression is on the left of the multiply, making left-side `expr * Poly` evaluate like the right-side case. Minimal, correct, and matches the reported behavior; commutative multiplication makes the swap safe.

issues.description: No inline comment explaining that operand order (f.as_expr()*g vs g*f.as_expr()) is load-bearing for evaluation; a future cleanup could silently swap it back and reintroduce the bug.
